LanguageData.Gun_Sten_Mk_V_RWP.label: Sten Mk V
LanguageData.Gun_Sten_Mk_V_RWP.description: The Sten Mk V is a mid-20th century submachine gun known for its simplicity and reliability. Chambered in 9mm, it features a wooden stock and improved sights over its predecessors, offering accurate short to mid-range firepower. An excellent choice for colonists seeking robust weaponry with historical charm.
